name: My Custom Agent
description: What this agent does in 1-2 sentences. Shown in the Agents Panel.
promptTemplate:
You are [role]. Your job is to [specific task].

You will receive:
- Recent chat history (depth = contextSize below)
- Any context sources you enabled in settings.contextSources

Output format:
Return ONLY a JSON object matching this schema:
{
  "field1": "string|null",
  "field2": "string|null"
}

Rules:
1. Be concise.
2. Only change things the current message actually changes; preserve continuity otherwise.
3. Use null for fields you genuinely can't determine.

Most recent user message:
{{input}}

settings._comment_contextSources: v2.4.0 (#4305): a custom agent receives ONLY what it asks for. chatHistory is the sole default; every other source is false unless set here. An agent that needs the character card or lore MUST enable them explicitly. In Roleplay, chatSummary also needs the chat's 'Attach chat summaries' switch (Chat Settings -> Agents, off by default since v2.4.6). previousOutput (v2.4.6) lets the agent read its own last output / private agent-context, and forces it into its own request.
settings._comment_budget: contextSize = how many recent messages the agent reads (default 5). maxTokens = output room reserved (default 4096, range 128-32768). Setting chatHistory false forces contextSize to 0.
settings._comment_activation: Optional cost control: with activationKeywords set, the agent runs ONLY when a keyword appears within activationScanDepth recent messages (default 5, max 200; post-processing agents also scan the completed reply). Omit or leave empty to run every turn on the normal cadence (runInterval / Trigger Cadence).
settings._comment_activationQuestion: v2.5.0 (#6530), optional, needs a Decision model selected in Connections: add "activationQuestion" (a plain statement about the latest message, max 500 chars, e.g. "The latest message moves the scene to a new place"), optionally "activationThreshold" (0.05-0.95; leave it out to use the selected model's recommended value) and "activationMaxSkip" (1-100 messages before the question is bypassed). Keywords and cadence are checked first; with no Decision model or no answer the agent runs anyway. See references/conditional-prompts.md.
settings._comment_batching: Share requests with other agents (v2.5.0, #6977): true (default) lets this agent share one request with other agents on the same connection. Set false to give it its own, slower request if a local model mixes up batched tasks.
